KODAK technical data E-2519 (May 2003), e2519.pdf, PDF page(s) 8, KODAK PROFESSIONAL SUPRA 400: https://125px.com/docs/film/kodak/e2519-2003_05.pdf Estimate placeholders (not on the sheet): individual CMY dyes reconstructed by the builder from the mid-scale neutral and D-min curves, sensitivity tails beyond the printed curves, hanatos2025 adaptation parameters (averaged from pinned Kodak negatives), interlayer DIR coupler strength (runtime default for negatives unless film_render_overrides says otherwise).
